objective: Show that inserting a cabled Borromean braid (a Y-clasper whose three leaves each encircle three co-oriented strands) into a knot K keeps H1(S^3_3(K)) = Z/3 and V, and changes T by l1 ^ l2 ^ l3, where l_j is the functional on V given by evaluating cocycles on leaf j. Hence the realizable forms include T_0 + A for every alternating F4-trilinear A on V. Check the predicted change by exact computation on explicit knots.
status: Proved by TRIPLE-PRODUCT-20261026-001C-P001: Y-surgery (Borromean surgery) along a Y-graph whose leaves lie in ker psi keeps H1 and V and changes the twisted triple product by l1 ^ l2 ^ l3, the determinant of the leaf functionals (Massuyeau's Lemma 3.2 lifted to the 3-fold cover, where the three lifts add with constant 3 = 1); every functional is a leaf, so the realizable forms on V include T0 + every alternating form, and on knot surgeries the moves are Borromean insertions. Checked exactly on 26 knots with failing controls.
title: Borromean insertions steer the twisted triple product
